verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a speech-to-text API vendor, since such vendors can offer on-prem or self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem option. Everything described is a hosted API reached through SDKs, WebSocket and HTTP, and dashboard data controls such as TTL and BAA do not amount to self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
